results.question: What are the top 10 product categories by total item price?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY total_price DESC
LIMIT 10
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 10;

results.question: Which sellers generated the highest total item price?

GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_item_price DESC
results.expected_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_item_price DESC;

results.question: Which customer states have the most orders?

results.question: Which five product categories generated the most total item price while having at least 100 order items?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_price,
    COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM
    order_items oi
JOIN
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY
    total_price DESC
LIMIT 5
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 5;

results.question: For each customer state, what is the total number of orders and the total payment value, ordered by total payment value?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_value), 0), 2) AS total_payment_value
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC
results.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC;
